context: Fix query projections/join suffixes at their source, express operations through the supported unified-frame API (adding generic facade support only where the operation is valid across backends), preserve SQL NULL aggregate semantics, and annotate the Data Vault generator/manifest with explicit loading metadata. Add focused regression tests by defect family, then rerun the full 44-cell probe.
description: A bounded SF=0.01 load-faithful probe executed 44 SQL/DataFrame cells for all 22 Data Vault queries and found 28 divergences. Group the related Data Vault defects in this item: duplicate load_dts/record_source columns during chained joins in both expression and pandas implementations; expression queries calling unsupported UnifiedLazyFrame APIs (agg, rename_columns, with_column); Q17 pandas returning 0.0 where SQL returns NULL; and generated-table loading that lacks durable CSV dialect metadata. Evidence: /tmp/datavault-cross-surface-probe.log (2026-08-16). These are product defects; do not baseline them.

preserves.behavior: Keep Data Vault SQL semantics, hash-key schema, lazy adapter imports, and backend-neutral unified-frame behavior; do not baseline execution errors or value mismatches.

verifications.expected: 44 of 44 cells compared with zero divergences
